requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 在 TM1637 四位数码管上每秒递增显示一个数字，模块引脚为 CLK=D4，DIO=D5。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply io_0 deltas summing to 0ms, then 1000ms (e.g., 10 steps of 100ms or any sequence whose total equals 1000ms), then another 1000ms with the same total-per-interval property.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 initial is 0; after the first 1000ms worth of accumulated io_0, io_1 becomes 1; after the next 1000ms, io_1 becomes 2. Increment occurs once per elapsed full 1s accumulated interval.
